description:
Unofficial desktop app for Facebook Messenger, without the rest of Facebook.

Chatpane wraps the Facebook Messenger web app in a small native window and strips away the rest of Facebook: no Feed, no Reels, no Marketplace. It adds native notifications, an unread badge and privacy options.
Chatpane is an independent open-source project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc. Messenger and Facebook are trademarks of Meta.
Pin your chats, get notified about reactions, and use Chatpane in any Facebook language.
What's New
- Pin chats. Right-click a chat and choose Pin chat to keep it in a Pinned section above the chat list. facebook.com has no pinning of its own.
- Reaction notifications. When someone reacts to one of your messages, you get a notification, like on your phone. Turn it off in Settings → Notifications → Reaction Notifications.
- Works in every Facebook language. Right-click menus, notification actions, keyboard shortcuts, Hide Names & Avatars and notifications no longer depend on Facebook being set to English.
- Mute from a notification mutes the chat for 8 hours without opening it, in any language.
- One message sound. Settings → Notifications → Message sound now plays once per new message, whether Chatpane is in front or not, and Messenger's own sound is one of the choices.
- Read receipts. Turn them on or off in Settings → Account.
- Your account in Settings. Settings → Account shows who is signed in, with a Log Out… button.
- Change Messenger's language after logging in, from Settings → General → Messenger Language.
- Double-click beside a message to reply, like the old Messenger desktop app.
- Schedule send has a new menu in Messenger's own style, with quick choices and a custom date and time.
- Passkey sign-in help. If a passkey is your only two-factor method, the login page explains how to get past the step that can't finish in Chatpane.
- Settings opens instantly, already filled in, without a blank window first.
- The Terminal theme uses a monospace font across the chat list too.
- winget. On Windows, install and update Chatpane with winget install chatpane.
- Make your own theme with the new theme guide.
Bug Fixes
- Windows: encrypted chats stopped syncing after reloading the window, until Chatpane rebuilt it about ten minutes later. Reloads now keep them working.
- Windows: Log Out could leave the old account's reset pending and wipe a later login on a following launch.
- Windows: a window restored at a size from a bigger screen hid the message box under the taskbar, and the Settings footer could sit under it too. Both now fit the screen.
- Chatpane did more and more background work the longer Messenger stayed open, which could slow it down and send one reaction notification hundreds of times.
- A reaction no longer shows a second banner, and a group message or a photo no longer raises two notifications.
- Group notifications keep the sender's photo.
- Quick replies from a notification are sent when Chatpane isn't in front.
- Messenger recovers by itself when it shows "Couldn't load chats".
- Hide Names covers names in event lines ("X added Y", poll votes), people just added to a group, and previews in every language.
- Download image, Share and Copy image work for every image, and Copy image works for JPEGs on Windows.
- Schedule send shows times on your locale's clock.
- Next conversation and Ctrl/Cmd+1–9 no longer open an empty page when no chat is open.
- The login page shows its form right away instead of invisible text for up to 15 seconds, and the cookie dialog no longer reappears after you enter your password.
- A settings.json saved with a byte order mark no longer resets all settings.
- Linux: no GTK menu bar over Chatpane's window controls, and WebKit's safe mode is no longer forced on niri. Settings windows and extra Messenger windows no longer leave their web processes running after they close.
- Updating from Carrier also carries over the logs, the macOS preferences and the saved zoom.
Internal
- Downloads, sharing and copying images use typed commands that only facebook.com and messenger.com can call.
- Linux software centers show fuller AppStream metadata and each release's notes.
- New releases are published to winget automatically.
